question: The value of the discriminant of the quadratic equation 7x² - 18x - 11 = 0 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify coefficients: **a = 7**, **b = −18**, **c = −11**.

Use the **Discriminant** formula: **D = b² − 4ac**.

D = (−18)² − 4 × 7 × (−11) = 324 + 308 = 632.

**∴ The correct answer is 632.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Quadratic Equation **7x² − 18x − 11 = 0**

**Formula Used:** For a general quadratic equation **ax² + bx + c = 0**, the **Discriminant (D)** is given by: **D = b² − 4ac**

⇒ Comparing **7x² − 18x − 11 = 0** with **ax² + bx + c = 0**

⇒ **a = 7**

⇒ **b = −18**

⇒ **c = −11**

⇒ **D = (−18)² − 4 × 7 × (−11)**

⇒ **D = 324 − (−308)**

⇒ **D = 324 + 308**

⇒ **D = 632**

**∴ The correct answer is 632.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Nature of Roots

If **D > 0**, the roots are **real and distinct**. If **D = 0**, the roots are **real and equal**. If **D < 0**, the roots are **imaginary**.

Quadratic Formula

The roots of the equation are calculated as **x = (−b ± √D) ÷ 2a**.

Sum and Product of Roots

Sum of roots = **−b/a** and Product of roots = **c/a**.</p
